Starting with homes built after high school, he expanded into commercial and multifamily projects. long_biography.plain_text:
At 18, Morris used two plots and seed funding provided by his maternal grandfather to construct a pair of houses. Selling them financed further acquisitions, turning a small central-New Jersey building venture into a diversified property platform. Through Edgewood, he oversees projects from land purchase and approvals to construction and landscaping.

Beyond development, the Morris family joined Hard Rock International and the Jingoli family in a casino investment; Hard Rock retained majority control. His civic career includes the founding chairmanship of RWJBarnabas Health and present leadership at RWJUH. Attorney Sheryl Weingarten Morris has helped guide the firm and shares the couple’s philanthropic work. None of those roles converts company real estate, casino interests or charitable institutions into assets belonging to Morris alone.
